Review found no bugs, no security issues and no line-count violations. I read the files only and ran nothing.

- **Line counts:** all under 30. server.js has 27 lines, index.html 15 and style.css 27.
- **Syntax:** I read server.js (lines 1-27) carefully and found no syntax errors. Parentheses, braces and the template literal on line 27 are balanced. `Object.hasOwn` on line 11 needs Node 16.9 or later.
- **Requirements:** every one is met.
  - **Routing:** `/` and `/index.html` serve the HTML and `/style.css` serves the CSS, each with the right content type (line 7).
  - **Safety:** the fixed whitelist uses `Object.hasOwn`, so `/__proto__` and similar names can't match, and no user input reaches `path.join` (line 16). Query strings and fragments are stripped (line 10).
  - **Errors and port:** other paths return 404 (lines 12-15). A failed read returns 500 (lines 17-20). It listens on `PORT` or 3000 (lines 26-27).
- **HTML and CSS:** index.html links `/style.css` (line 7). style.css is a dark theme with a `#121418` background and light text (lines 2-3, 17-18).
- **Minor, not violations:**
  - Line 11 returns 404 for non-GET methods, where 405 would be more precise.
  - There is no `X-Content-Type-Options` header.
  - Nothing is open for the Lead.

Files are in `<path>`: `server.js`, `index.html`, `style.css`.
